page.layout: One column of text, right of centre, with marginal notes in the left margin beside the lines starting "Neque tantum" and "Ut institutum". The catchword stands alone at the lower right under the last line.

main_text.p: quis modo aliquem provocas-set. Id quod faciendum monuerat Episcopus Aturensis[?], ut scilicet edita Henrici 4. executioni mandarentur, ne Rex, dum delicto, quos stringere debebat, per dissimulationem & impunitatem habenas laxat, toties cum omnibus peccans, quoties illi duellantes se damnant, cumulum peccatorum sibi coacervet.

Marta dig.jur. noviss. Tom.2. tit. de duell.c. 5. Dist. const.Or. din.Holl.Neque tantum in ipsos provocantes, sed etiam in adjun-ctos, quos secundos, aut terti-os appellant, etiam patronos, (quorum erat armorum æqua-liratem definire, & prospicere ne cuiquam fraus fieret) æque atque in duellatores, ultimo supplicio animadvertendum erat. Quod etiam factum fuisse ex decisione Rotæ Lucensis, refert Marta.
Treutl. vol.2. disp.32. Bokel. disq pu-bl. 2. quaest.8.Ut institutum quorundam maxime detestandum, quo duellatoribus, homicidis loca tuta assignantur, & refugii

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Aturensis" (the letters after "Atu" are unclear, possibly "Atwrenfis"). The catchword "afyla" is printed with a long s and is transcribed as "asyla". The left-margin citations are set in small type; their line division is approximate. The printed "difp" and "difq" are read as "disp" and "disq".
